description: Fetch a public web page and return its metadata: title, description, canonical URL, language, OpenGraph and Twitter card tags, icons and parsed JSON-LD blocks. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account; nothing is charged for a bad input).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (x402 v2 payment payload signed for one entry of the `accepts` list returned when this tool is called without it). Omit to get the price and payment requirements.

name: page_metadata
title: Web page metadata ($0.005/call)
